text:
lee: Heads-up: we hit ~95% vGPU utilization in us-west-2 spot pool during the 02:10 spike. Saw ~15% preemptions over ~2m.
maya: Yikes. Any sign the autoscaler over-reacted or under-reacted?
sam: Autoscaler did a hard +16 node desired increase, then cooldown blocked further scale for 90s, surge throttle prevented more nodes -> queue ballooned.
lee: Logs: `autoscaler:decision delta=+16 reason=queue_backpressure` then `surge:throttle active`. Backoff + preempt churn meant wasted warmup.
jules: Proposal: introduce a "soft-ramp" (rate-limited desired adjustments) + a capacity-braking window that caps % change in desired per interval. Also add a small emergency override if p99 latency > SLA.
maya: I like the braking idea. Concrete: cap changes to 20% desired per 30s and a ramp-rate of +3 nodes/15s?
sam: Instead of hard numbers, parametrize: `ramp_rate`, `max_surge_pct`, `ramp_window_sec`, `cooldown_sec`, `hedge_pool_min`. Keep emergency_override boolean.
infra-bot: Suggested config snippet for spot-autoscaler:
```yaml
scale_policy:
  ramp_window_sec: 30
  ramp_rate_nodes_per_sec: 0.2  # ~3 nodes / 15s for typical pool sizes
  max_surge_pct: 0.20
  cooldown_sec: 90
  emergency_override:
    enabled: true
    p99_latency_ms: 2000
hedge_pool:
  min_reserved: 4
  preempt_threshold: 0.10  # if measured preempt prob > 10%, start hedging
fallback_policy:
  prefer_local_hedge: true
  cross_region_fallbacks: ["us-east-1", "us-west-1"]
  cross_region_max_minutes_per_hour: 10
```
lee: Good. Question on fallback: should we prefer spinning warm hedges locally before cross-region routing? Cross-region costs egress/latency.
sam: Yes — policy should prefer local hedges first. Cross-region only if hedge exhausted or if estimated added latency < routing_threshold_ms. Also add a cost budget cap to avoid surprises.
maya: Can we add interruption-weighted triggers? e.g., if queue growth AND preempt_prob>threshold then favor hedge_pool scaling instead of spot-scaleout.
jules: Yep. We'll compute an interruption score per AZ/pool and factor into decision: `score = preempt_prob * running_workload_weight + recent_eviction_rate`.
lee: Also: avoid immediate GC of KV cache during downscale. Add `grace_sec` 120 to keep nodes around for KV flush.
sam: I'll PR to autoscaler: implement ramp limiter + max_surge_pct + interruption-aware decision. Will include simulation harness.
jules: I'll run a 24h replay with our preemption trace and sequence-length distribution to estimate extra token-cost vs saved infra cost. Will report numbers.
ops-bot: Created alert `infra.autoscale.softramp.p99` -> trigger @oncall when p99 > 2000ms for 5m.
maya: Also add metric for surge-throttle-events per hour and hedged-fallbacks per deployment.
lee: For rollout: canary `soft-ramp` on a single heavy inference deployment in us-west for 6 hours at off-peak. Watch p99, token-cost delta, and number of cross-region fallbacks.
sam: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/512 (draft) — includes config + unit tests.
maya: One more: annotate deployments with `redwood/autoscale: soft-ramp-v1` so we can filter dashboards.
jules: Will post sim results here in ~2h. If numbers look good, schedule org rollout next Wed morning.
lee: Thanks all.
